decisions: Store cbXRP DEX liquidity and turnover by pool, venue, pair, block/time and provider; do not treat aggregate 24-hour volume or buy/sell trade counts as net capital flow.
Keep pool liquidity, token market cap, reserve collateral and wrapped supply as separate measurements. A 7.36x volume-to-main-pool-liquidity ratio is turnover, not an inflow or price signal.

Quarantine stale/inconsistent CoinDesk and Trading Strategy cbXRP supply values; use Coinbase's first-party reserve/supply display as the best published baseline until independent Base totalSupply() verification is obtained.
Track cbXRP mint/burn events against the 20 Coinbase XRPL reserve addresses and Base totalSupply() at common block/time cutoffs to estimate actual locked XRP and redemptions.
No cbXRP DEX or supply observation from this snapshot is admitted to the XRP price-prediction feature store.
invariants: Third-party supply pages are inconsistent and cannot override the first-party Coinbase reserve/supply display.
DEX volume is not net capital; buy/sell counts are not notional amounts.
cbXRP is a wrapped asset backed by Coinbase-held XRP; do not count its Base market capitalization as incremental XRP market capitalization.
